classification.difficultyReason: Plot each point and apply the explicitly supplied horizontal and vertical shifts, then label and record the image coordinates.

content.prompt: Copy the points listed below onto your graph paper and translate them 3 units right and 1 unit up. Be careful to label each point and its image. Also write down the coordinates of each image point.

answer.worked: Move $A$ 3 grid units right and 1 grid unit up. Label the image $A'(3,1)$.
Move $B$ 3 grid units right and 1 grid unit up. Label the image $B'(4,3)$.
Move $C$ 3 grid units right and 1 grid unit up. Label the image $C'(1,2)$.
Move $D$ 3 grid units right and 1 grid unit up. Label the image $D'(-2,-4)$.

spec.description: Complete common coordinate plane showing all original points and their translated images; B and C′ coincide.
